meta.title: Pricing — Perelai
meta.description: Information about Perelai features and workspace access.

hero.title: What you get today
hero.body: Perelai provides booking, client, and cash flow management. Here is what is available in the workspace.

capabilities.title: Current capabilities
capabilities.inbox: Operational Inbox — one list of what still needs your decision, kept until resolved
capabilities.calendar: Calendar that shows the kind of work you actually do
capabilities.booking: Public booking link — your clients choose a service and time directly on your page
capabilities.clients: Client profiles with visit history, notes and payment records
capabilities.payments: Payment recording and allocation against visits and orders
capabilities.finance: Revenue, costs and outstanding balances without a spreadsheet
capabilities.orders: Orders with agreed payment schedules and instalment tracking
capabilities.packages: Packages of prepaid credits that draw down as you use them
capabilities.onboarding: Niche-aware onboarding with 32 selectable business types and editable service lists
capabilities.contactImport: Contact import from your phone via vCard
capabilities.languages: Available in English, Ukrainian and Polish

noCharge.title: Booking & Workspace
noCharge.commissionDetail: Your booking link is yours. Clients book directly on your link.
noCharge.cardDetail: Confirm your email to finish setting up your workspace.

future.title: What happens when billing arrives

faq.title: Questions about pricing and billing
faq.a1: There is no billing system in the app today. Pricing and terms will be announced in advance before any billing ships.
faq.q2: What happens when billing terms are announced?
faq.a2: Pricing terms will be announced in advance so you will have time to review before anything changes.
faq.a3: Your booking link is yours. Clients select a service and time directly on your page.

cta.title: Your clients, bookings and cash flow — in one place
cta.micro: You'll get a verification email to finish setting up.
